column1: !!SBtab TableID='ConfigureEFM' TableType='Config' SBtabVersion='1.2' Method='efm-enumeration' TableName='Default options of EFM enumeration (Matlab)'
% Default options of the Matlab implementation, assembled from the arguments of network_efmtool.m (Metabolic Network Toolbox).
% Empty values: option is empty by default ([] in Matlab); vector-valued options are
% described in the column !Description. Flags: 1 (true) or 0 (false).
% These settings are function arguments of network_efmtool (no options struct).

column3: 'internal': only internal metabolites must be stationary (all stationary modes); 'total': external metabolites must be stationary as well
Indices of reactions (e.g. biomass production) to be neglected
Vector of flux benefit values; if given, only modes without flux benefit are returned
Omit one of two modes that differ only by a factor -1
Reactions that must be active in the modes
